observations: Photo 0: Front view of a smartphone with vertical colored lines (green, pink, white) across the screen, indicating display failure. The screen is on, showing home screen icons and a wallpaper. The phone has a punch-hole camera at the top center.
Photo 1: Back view of the phone, white color, with a triple camera module in a rectangular housing on the top left. The brand 'SAMSUNG' is visible at the bottom center of the back panel.
Photo 2: Another front view, same as photo 0, showing the same vertical lines on the screen. The time and battery percentage (86%) are visible at the top.
The screen is not cracked; the lines are digital artifacts, suggesting a dead or damaged display panel.

risks.risk: The phone may have other internal faults not visible in the photos, such as battery issues or software corruption.
risks.proof: A video showing the phone powering on, charging, and responding to touch, or a diagnostic screen.

Close-up of the screen under different lighting to check for physical cracks or touch responsiveness.

response.reason: The item is identifiable as a Samsung Galaxy S21. The screen has a severe display fault (vertical lines), which contradicts the seller's claim of a cracked screen. The phone is priced at its worst case: not working, due to the display failure. The risks are listed, but the item can be priced based on its current condition.
